name: Cárcheles (Spain)
description: Green field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cárcheles (a tower between a ladder and a key on red).
history: Municipal flag of Cárcheles; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Cárcheles arms — tower between a ladder and a key on red
tower, ladder, key and crown of the arms
